answer: Because the timing is written down against the comet challenge, the jetty audit can replay the wharf history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 254 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4205 identities would post 3549 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
